meta.title: RFQ bid: Quote only one of two products
gaps: The catalog cannot represent the alternative valid outcome where partial quoting is allowed, or record either refusal or acceptance as a passing result.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot represent the alternative valid outcome where partial quoting is allowed, or record either refusal or acceptance as a passing result.

steps.note: Create the RFQ event needed for the vendor-portal scenario.
A title is required before publishing the test event.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Create the two products required by the case.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet so the RFQ can be published.
Invite the QA vendor used for the vendor-portal session.
Make the RFQ live for the vendor.
Verify that the RFQ reached a published project page.
Move to the separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Enter a price in only the first matching product price field, leaving the other product unquoted.
